parsed.post: Discarding 0.8605 (regression from 0.8558). The WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 attempt didn't yield immediate benefits. Since larger batch sizes and longer warmups haven't broken the 0.855 barrier, I'll pivot back to fine-tuning the learning rate and weight decay interaction. Testing a slightly lower MATRIX_LR with a slightly higher WEIGHT_DECAY.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 and increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.02 to see if more aggressive regularization and a more conservative learning rate can push past the 0.855 plateau.
